newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Violence cost 50 mln rand lost output - GFSA.
newsitem.headline: Violence cost 50 mln rand lost output - GFSA.

text.p: Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd said on Friday that recent violence at its Driefontein Conslidated Ltd and Kloof Gold Ming Co Ltd gold mines had cost 50 million rand in lost output.
Gold Fields said East Driefontein had been affected by continued violent conflcits among employees since July 18, during which 34 workers were killed.

During this time, operations have been affected by sporadic stoppages resulting in the loss in total of six shifts to date. In addition, some 1,700 employees, or 14 percent of the workforce, have not yet reported for work.
Total revenue losses to Driefontein during the period are estimated at 35 million rand, Gold Fields said in a statement.

At Kloof's Leeudoorn division, operations were halted from August 20 to 28 with a total loss of eight shifts. Some 1,100 employees, or 16 percent of the workforce, have yet to resume work. Five workers have been killed at Leeudoorn.
Total revenue losses to Kloof during the period are estimated at 15 million rand.
